error: SLURM job stuck in PD state with reason Resources
cause: Requested CPUs or memory not available in partition
solution: Reduce resource request or wait for nodes to free up. Check partition limits with sinfo.
commands: squeue -j <jobid>; scontrol show job <jobid>; sinfo -p <partition>

error: SLURM job stuck in PD state with reason ReqNodeNotAvail
cause: Requested node is down drained or reserved
solution: Remove node constraint or wait for node to return. Check node state.
commands: sinfo -N; scontrol show node <node>; scontrol update NodeName=<node> State=RESUME

error: SLURM job stuck in PD state with reason Priority
cause: Higher priority jobs ahead in queue
solution: Nothing to do but wait unless you have fair-share priority. Check your priority score.
commands: sprio -j <jobid>; sshare -u <username>

error: SLURM job stuck in PD state with reason Dependency
cause: Job waiting for a dependent job to complete successfully
solution: Check the dependency chain. Cancel and resubmit if dependent job failed.
commands: squeue -j <jobid>; scontrol show job <jobid> | grep Depend

error: SLURM job in CG state for more than 10 minutes
cause: Process inside job not terminating cleanly after walltime
solution: Force cancel with scancel -f. If recurring check epilog scripts.
commands: scancel -f <jobid>; scontrol show job <jobid>

error: SLURM job killed with reason OOM
cause: Job exceeded requested memory limit
solution: Increase --mem or --mem-per-cpu in job script. Check actual peak usage with sacct.
commands: sacct -j <jobid> --format=JobID,MaxRSS,MaxVMSize; scontrol show job <jobid>

error: SLURM job exceeded walltime and was killed
cause: Job ran longer than --time limit
solution: Profile runtime and increase walltime. Use checkpointing for long jobs.
commands: sacct -j <jobid> --format=JobID,Elapsed,Timelimit

error: squeue shows job in R state but no output file produced
cause: Job running on node but application crashed immediately
solution: Check job stdout and stderr files for application errors.
commands: cat slurm-<jobid>.out; scontrol show job <jobid> | grep StdOut

error: Cannot submit jobs - sbatch returns error QOSMaxJobsPerUserLimit
cause: User has reached maximum concurrent job limit for QOS
solution: Wait for running jobs to finish or request limit increase from admin.
commands: squeue -u <username>; sacctmgr show qos <qosname>

error: Node marked as drained with reason not responding
cause: Node missed heartbeat to slurmctld - possible crash or network issue
solution: Check node health. Restart slurmd if node is up. Resume after verification.
commands: ping <node>; ssh <node> systemctl status slurmd; scontrol update NodeName=<node> State=RESUME

error: slurmctld service not running on head node
cause: Service crashed or was stopped. Check logs for reason.
solution: Restart slurmctld and check logs for root cause before restarting.
commands: systemctl status slurmctld; journalctl -u slurmctld -n 50; systemctl restart slurmctld

error: slurmd not running on compute node
cause: Service crashed network partition or node rebooted
solution: SSH to node and restart slurmd. Check logs first.
commands: ssh <node>; systemctl status slurmd; journalctl -u slurmd -n 50; systemctl restart slurmd

error: MPI job hangs after launch with no output
cause: Deadlock between ranks or network communication failure
solution: Run with verbose MPI flags to identify hanging rank. Check interconnect.
commands: mpirun --mca btl_base_verbose 100 ./app; mpirun --display-map ./app

error: MPI_ERR_TRUNCATE error during execution
cause: Receive buffer too small for incoming message
solution: Fix application code to allocate larger receive buffer matching send size.
commands: mpirun --mca btl_base_verbose 1 -np 4 ./app 2>&1 | grep ERR

error: MPI ranks cannot find each other at startup
cause: Hostfile incorrect or SSH between nodes failing
solution: Verify hostfile entries and test passwordless SSH between all nodes.
commands: cat hostfile; ssh <node2> hostname; mpirun --hostfile hostfile --display-map ./app

error: Infiniband link shows as down in ibstat
cause: Physical cable issue driver problem or port disabled
solution: Check physical connections. Restart opensmd. Check driver status.
commands: ibstat; ibstatus; systemctl restart opensmd; dmesg | grep -i infiniband

error: MPI job performance much slower than expected
cause: Falling back to TCP instead of Infiniband
solution: Force Infiniband transport. Check that all ranks are using ib0 interface.
commands: mpirun --mca btl openib,self ./app; ibstat; mpirun --mca pml ob1 ./app

error: mpirun reports more processes than slots
cause: Hostfile slot count less than -np value
solution: Increase slots in hostfile or reduce -np count to match available slots.
commands: cat hostfile; mpirun --display-map -np 8 ./app

error: Permission denied accessing /scratch filesystem
cause: Wrong group membership or file permissions set incorrectly
solution: Check group and fix permissions. Verify user is in correct group.
commands: ls -la /scratch; id; groups; chmod 750 /scratch/<dir>; chgrp <group> /scratch/<dir>

error: Disk quota exceeded on home directory
cause: User files exceed allocated storage quota
solution: Find large files and delete or move to scratch. Request quota increase.
commands: quota -s; du -sh ~/*; find ~ -size +1G -type f; df -h

error: module load command not found
cause: Environment modules not initialized in current shell
solution: Source the modules init script or add to bashrc.
commands: source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh; module avail; module load <name>

error: module load succeeds but binary still not found
cause: Module loaded but PATH not updated correctly
solution: Check module sets PATH. Manually verify binary location.
commands: module show <name>; echo $PATH; which <binary>; module purge; module load <name>

error: SSH connection refused to compute node
cause: sshd not running on compute node or firewall blocking port 22
solution: Check sshd status on node. Verify firewall rules allow SSH.
commands: systemctl status sshd; firewall-cmd --list-all; ss -tlnp | grep 22

error: High load average on login node causing slowness
cause: Too many CPU-intensive processes running on login node
solution: Kill heavy processes and move them to compute nodes via SLURM.
commands: uptime; top -b -n1 | head -20; ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -10

error: Cannot write to NFS mounted filesystem
cause: NFS mount stale or NFS server down
solution: Check NFS mount status. Remount if stale. Contact admin if server down.
commands: df -h; mount | grep nfs; showmount -e <nfsserver>; umount -l /mount/point; mount /mount/point

error: Process killed unexpectedly with signal 9
cause: OOM killer invoked because system ran out of memory
solution: Check dmesg for OOM kill events. Reduce memory usage or add swap.
commands: dmesg | grep -i 'killed process'; free -h; cat /proc/meminfo

error: Cannot load shared library error at runtime
cause: Library not in LD_LIBRARY_PATH or module not loaded
solution: Load correct module or set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to include library directory.
commands: ldd ./app; echo $LD_LIBRARY_PATH; module load <name>; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/path/to/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH

error: Cron job not executing on schedule
cause: Cron daemon not running or syntax error in crontab
solution: Check crond status and validate crontab syntax.
commands: systemctl status crond; crontab -l; grep CRON /var/log/syslog

error: Job script failing with bad interpreter error
cause: Wrong line endings in script or incorrect shebang path
solution: Convert line endings to Unix format. Verify bash path.
commands: file myjob.sh; dos2unix myjob.sh; head -1 myjob.sh; which bash

error: GPU not detected by application
cause: CUDA module not loaded or GPU not allocated in SLURM job
solution: Load CUDA module and request GPU in job script with --gres.
commands: nvidia-smi; module load cuda; echo $CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; scontrol show job <jobid> | grep Gres
